title: WaterSound "The Salty Deer" 85 S Founders Lane
h1: WaterSound "The Salty Deer" 85 S Founders Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Gated Community with on-site Security- Gulf views- Steps from the beach- Across from the Dunesider pool- Access to WaterSound bridges and nature trails- Rooftop terrace- Multiple balconies- High-end furnishings- Flat-screen TVs in every bedroom- 6 adult bikes- From March 1st to October 31st, the rental of this property includes one beach -service set (2 beach chairs and 1umbrella)- Private Deeded Beach Access- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutThis property comes with 2 designated parking spaces. This home permits a maximum of 2 vehicles through the community security gate.*Unfortunately, the indoor and outdoor fireplaces are not for guest use.DETAILS: Coastal elegance! Across from the Dunesider pool and just a few steps from the beautiful WaterSound beach is the brand new "Salty Deer," a 6-bedroom, 6.5-bathroom home that sleeps 14 guests. With unique architecture on the exterior and high-end furnishings and premium appliances on the interior, luxury will never be sacrificed. Inside, exposed brick walls and rustic wooden beams line the ceilings and doors of every floor. On the first level, there is a screened-in porch, laundry room, living area, and 3 bedrooms. The first has a king bed, the second a queen and the third contains 2 twin bunks - all with private bathrooms. The second floor is the main level of the home and opens the main living room and kitchen up to a wrap-around balcony. The gourmet kitchen features premium, stainless-steel appliances, casual seating at the bar for 6, and a dining table that can seat 8 guests. The spacious living area opens up to the balcony with sliding French doors to let in the fresh, salty air during warmer months. The balcony has ample outdoor seating and porch swing. More guest rooms are down the hall, one with a king bed and private bathroom and the other with a queen and private bathroom. Upstairs, a primary suite takes control of the floor with a large bedroom and spa bathroom that features floor-to-ceiling marble finishes in the shower room, double vanity, and soaking tub. Access to the top-floor rooftop terrace is down the hall. The terrace has stunning panoramic Gulf views under the covered balcony. In addition to all of the wonderful amenities of the home, it also comes with 6 adult bikes, a grill, and exclusive access to all of WaterSound's boardwalks, pools, and nature trails. Don't miss your chance to book this spectacular home today! If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.
